subject: general
question: When passing stationary vehicles, keep a watch on_________ who may come out suddenly from the front of the stationary vehicle. While overtaking, it should be done on the_____ side. Always keep a good________ between your vehicle and others.
solution:
The correct answer is __pedestrians**(right; distance)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When passing stationary vehicles, it is important to watch for pedestrians__ who may suddenly come out from the front of the vehicle.
 
• While overtaking, it should always be done on the __right__ side.
 
• Maintaining a safe distance between vehicles is essential for preventing accidents and ensuring safety.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Driving Tips:**

 
 
• Be cautious near stationary vehicles as pedestrians might step out unexpectedly.
 
• Always overtake from the correct side and ensure visibility before making any move.
 
• Maintain a safe distance to allow for sudden braking or emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Road Safety:**
 
 
• Follow traffic rules and be mindful of pedestrians and other vehicles on the road.
 
• Avoid distractions and focus on the surroundings while driving.
